name: claude-pulse-monitor
description: Monitor Claude Code usage, sessions, subagents and token consumption from your VS Code status bar — and terminate runaway sessions from the dashboard.

commands.title: Claude Pulse: Terminate a Claude Session

claudePulse.statusBar.showResetTimer.description: Show session reset countdown in status bar

claudePulse.statusBar.showTokenCount.description: Show today's message count in status bar

claudePulse.statusBar.showSessionCount.description: Show today's session count in status bar

claudePulse.statusBar.showModel.description: Show the Claude model currently in use (e.g. 'Opus 5') in the status bar

claudePulse.statusBar.showEffort.description: Show the model's reasoning effort level (e.g. 'xhigh') in the status bar. Read from the active session transcript, falling back to the global effortLevel in ~/.claude/settings.json.

claudePulse.statusBar.showCacheWarmth.description: Show an approximate countdown of how long the prompt cache stays warm (e.g. '~59m'). Inferred from the last request, not reported by Claude Code.

claudePulse.statusBar.showScopedUsage.description: Show model-specific weekly usage in the status bar once it registers above 0% (e.g. 'Fable 2% 4d 5h'). These windows are sub-caps within the overall weekly limit.

claudePulse.sessionResetIntervalMinutes.description: Session reset interval in minutes (e.g., 300 = 5 hours for Pro plan)

claudePulse.sessionTokenLimit.description: Estimated token limit per 5h session window (used for usage % calculation). Calibrate by comparing with /usage in Claude CLI. Default 8M works for Max plan.

claudePulse.pollingIntervalSeconds.description: How often to refresh data from Claude files (seconds)

claudePulse.usageRefreshIntervalSeconds.description: How often to refresh usage data from the Anthropic API (seconds). Default is 3600 (1 hour). Minimum 60s.

claudePulse.notifications.onNewSession.description: Notify when a new Claude session starts

claudePulse.notifications.onSessionEnd.description: Notify when a Claude session ends

claudePulse.notifications.onResetTimerCo.description: Notify when the session reset timer reaches zero

claudePulse.notifications.onTaskComplete.description: Notify when Claude finishes a task and is waiting for input

claudePulse.notifications.onApiRefresh.description: Show a confirmation notification when API usage data is manually refreshed (e.g. 'API data refreshed successfully'). Disable to silence these toasts; errors and warnings are always shown.

claudePulse.taskCompletionIdleSeconds.description: Seconds of inactivity after Claude's last response before considering a task complete (default: 10)

claudePulse.claudeHomePath.description: Custom path to .claude directory (leave empty for ~/.claude)

claudePulse.showAgentMap.description: Show the Agents section in the dashboard, listing the subagents the current session spawned and what each one cost. Scanning reads subagent transcripts, so it runs only while the dashboard is open.

claudePulse.showAgentGraph.description: Show the Agent Graph section in the dashboard: every Claude session on this machine with the subagents it spawned, and a button to terminate a session. Scans only while the dashboard is open.

claudePulse.promptCacheTtlMinutes.description: How long the prompt cache is assumed to stay warm, in minutes. Lower this if you are on an account served a shorter cache TTL.

scripts.release: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run package
